basic.name: 普通攻击：跳步刃舞
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多六段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
发动第六段[普通攻击]同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]，且招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to six consecutive attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.
The sixth Basic Attack is also treated as a Dash Attack, and Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

special.name: 特殊技：掠空
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动连续踢击后横扫，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：掠空-横扫
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Clearout
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动多次连续踢击后横扫，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，且同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a Dash Attack.

dodge.name: 闪避：残影
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的滑步闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
简拥有一次额外的闪避次数，在进入[狂热]状态前，简会交替使用两段闪避，在进入[狂热]状态后，简在闪避时可以穿过前方的敌人。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to trigger.
A quick slide dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jane has an extra dodge. Before she enters the Passion state, she alternates between the two dodges. After entering the Passion state, Jane can pass through enemies in front when dodging.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：刀刃跳
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
若衔接在一段闪避后，将向前方进行上挑斩击，造成物理伤害；
若衔接在二段闪避后，将向前方进行连续斩击，造成物理伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
If after the first dodge, launch an upward slash in front, dealing Physical DMG.
If after the second dodge, perform a consecutive slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：疾影
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
若衔接在一段闪避后，将对前方敌人发动多次斩击，随后向下突刺，造成物理伤害；
若衔接在二段闪避后，将会跃起并对前方敌人发动三次连续攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
If after the first dodge, unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Physical DMG.
If after the second dodge, leap up and deliver three consecutive attacks to enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：罪孽生花
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿梭斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，简将直接进入[狂热]状态，并使[狂热心流]回复至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：终幕演出
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力穿梭斩击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，简将直接进入[狂热]状态，并使[狂热心流]回复至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies with a powerful attack in a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：乌刺
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次斩击，随后向下突刺，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：最后防线
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：疾风扫
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起后对敌人发动快速斩击，随后在前方大范围内再次发动横扫斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Leap up and swiftly slash the enemy, then execute a wide sweeping slash across a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.text: 简攻击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[啮咬]状态，持续10秒；队伍中任意角色对处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人触发[强击]并施加[畏缩]效果时，[畏缩]效果的持续时间提升5秒；对处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人造成的[强击]伤害有概率触发暴击，基础暴击率为40%，暴击伤害为50%，简的每点异常精通会使该效果的暴击率额外提升0.16%。
fields.textEn: When Jane's attacks hit an enemy, it causes them to enter the Gnawed state, lasting for 10s. If any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state and causes the Flinch effect, the Flinch effect duration is extended by 5s. Assault DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit against enemies in the Gnawed state, with a base CRIT Rate of 40% and CRIT DMG of 50%. Each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency further increases this CRIT Rate by 0.16%.

fields.text:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
简的物理异常积蓄效率提升20%，当敌人已经处于属性异常状态下时，简对其累积的物理异常积蓄值额外提升15%。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 20%. When the enemy is already suffering from an Attribute Anomaly, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup towards the target is increased by an additional 15%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：跳步刃舞
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多六段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
发动第六段[普通攻击]同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]，且招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to six consecutive attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.
The sixth Basic Attack is also treated as a Dash Attack, and Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

basic.name: 狂热
basic.description:
简触发[极限闪避]、[招架支援]或发动招式对敌人造成伤害时，会累积[狂热心流]，当[狂热心流]累积至上限时，简将进入[狂热]状态；
[狂热]状态下，简的物理异常积蓄效率提升25%，此外，若简的异常精通高于120点，每超过1点异常精通会使自身的攻击力提升2点，通过这种方式最多使自身的攻击力提升600点；
简在[狂热]状态下发动招式造成伤害时，会消耗[狂热心流]，触发[极限闪避]或[招架支援]时，可以回复[狂热心流]，当[狂热心流]耗尽时，将退出[狂热]状态。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Jane triggers Perfect Dodge, Defensive Assist, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates Passion Stream. Upon reaching the maximum Passion Stream, Jane enters the Passion state.
While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the Passion state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume Passion Stream. Activating a Perfect Dodge or Defensive Assist regenerates Passion Stream. Jane exits the Passion state when all of her Passion Stream is consumed.

basic.name: 普通攻击：萨霍夫跳
basic.description:
进入[狂热]状态时，简将获得一次[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]的可使用次数；
当有可使用次数时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动快速的连续攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成物理伤害；
连续攻击期间，保持长按可以大幅延长招式的持续时间，松开 【普通攻击键】 可以提前发动终结一击；
连续攻击发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，终结一击发动期间具有无敌效果，且发动时可触发极限闪避；
若触发极限闪避，则提升终结一击命中敌人时回复的[狂热心流]；
在[狂热]状态下发动[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]对敌人造成伤害时，可以回复[狂热心流]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Entering the Passion state grants Jane one use of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump.
When available, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to greatly extend the skill duration. Release [Basic Attack] to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move, which can also trigger a Perfect Dodge upon activation.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered, the Finishing Move restores more Passion Stream on hit.
Using and damaging an enemy with Basic Attack: Salchow Jump while in the Passion state generates Passion Stream.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：刀刃跳

闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
若衔接在一段闪避后，将向前方进行上挑斩击，造成物理伤害；
若衔接在二段闪避后，将向前方进行连续斩击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
If after the first dodge, launch an upward slash in front, dealing Physical DMG.
If after the second dodge, perform a consecutive slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：虚像突刺
basic.description:
[狂热]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行三次快速的突进斩击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch three quick rushing slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

fields.trigger: 简触发[极限闪避]、[招架支援]或发动招式对敌人造成伤害时，会累积[狂热心流]，当[狂热心流]累积至上限时，简将进入[狂热]状态；
fields.triggerEn: When Jane triggers Perfect Dodge, Defensive Assist, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates Passion Stream. Upon reaching the maximum Passion Stream, Jane enters the Passion state.
fields.description:
简触发[极限闪避]、[招架支援]或发动招式对敌人造成伤害时，会累积[狂热心流]，当[狂热心流]累积至上限时，简将进入[狂热]状态；
[狂热]状态下，简的物理异常积蓄效率提升25%，此外，若简的异常精通高于120点，每超过1点异常精通会使自身的攻击力提升2点，通过这种方式最多使自身的攻击力提升600点；
简在[狂热]状态下发动招式造成伤害时，会消耗[狂热心流]，触发[极限闪避]或[招架支援]时，可以回复[狂热心流]，当[狂热心流]耗尽时，将退出[狂热]状态。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Jane triggers Perfect Dodge, Defensive Assist, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates Passion Stream. Upon reaching the maximum Passion Stream, Jane enters the Passion state.
While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the Passion state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume Passion Stream. Activating a Perfect Dodge or Defensive Assist regenerates Passion Stream. Jane exits the Passion state when all of her Passion Stream is consumed.

fields.name: 普通攻击：萨霍夫跳
fields.trigger: 当有可使用次数时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When available, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
进入[狂热]状态时，简将获得一次[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]的可使用次数；
当有可使用次数时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动快速的连续攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成物理伤害；
连续攻击期间，保持长按可以大幅延长招式的持续时间，松开 【普通攻击键】 可以提前发动终结一击；
连续攻击发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，终结一击发动期间具有无敌效果，且发动时可触发极限闪避；
若触发极限闪避，则提升终结一击命中敌人时回复的[狂热心流]；
在[狂热]状态下发动[普通攻击：萨霍夫跳]对敌人造成伤害时，可以回复[狂热心流]。
fields.descriptionEn:
Entering the Passion state grants Jane one use of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump.
When available, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to greatly extend the skill duration. Release [Basic Attack] to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move, which can also trigger a Perfect Dodge upon activation.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered, the Finishing Move restores more Passion Stream on hit.
Using and damaging an enemy with Basic Attack: Salchow Jump while in the Passion state generates Passion Stream.

fields.name: 特殊技：掠空
fields.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动连续踢击后横扫，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：掠空-横扫
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Clearout
fields.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动多次连续踢击后横扫，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，且同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a Dash Attack.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：掠空-强袭（潜能觉醒）
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught (Potential Awakening)
fields.trigger: [狂热]状态下，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: While in the Passion state and with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
[狂热]状态下，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，向前方发动多次连续踢击后横扫，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，且同时视为发动[冲刺攻击]。
fields.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state and with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a Dash Attack.

fields.name: 闪避：残影
fields.trigger: 点按 【闪避键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Dodge] to trigger.
fields.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的滑步闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
简拥有一次额外的闪避次数，在进入[狂热]状态前，简会交替使用两段闪避，在进入[狂热]状态后，简在闪避时可以穿过前方的敌人。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to trigger.
A quick slide dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jane has an extra dodge. Before she enters the Passion state, she alternates between the two dodges. After entering the Passion state, Jane can pass through enemies in front when dodging.

fields.name: 冲刺攻击：刀刃跳
fields.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
fields.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
若衔接在一段闪避后，将向前方进行上挑斩击，造成物理伤害；
若衔接在二段闪避后，将向前方进行连续斩击，造成物理伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
If after the first dodge, launch an upward slash in front, dealing Physical DMG.
If after the second dodge, perform a consecutive slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

fields.name: 冲刺攻击：虚像突刺
fields.trigger: [狂热]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: While in the Passion state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
fields.description:
[狂热]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行三次快速的突进斩击，造成物理伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch three quick rushing slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

fields.name: 闪避反击：疾影
fields.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
fields.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
若衔接在一段闪避后，将对前方敌人发动多次斩击，随后向下突刺，造成物理伤害；
若衔接在二段闪避后，将会跃起并对前方敌人发动三次连续攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
If after the first dodge, unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Physical DMG.
If after the second dodge, leap up and deliver three consecutive attacks to enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 闪避反击：疾影连舞
fields.trigger: [狂热]状态下，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: While in the Passion state, press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
fields.description:
[狂热]状态下，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state, press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 连携技：罪孽生花
fields.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
fields.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
fields.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿梭斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，简将直接进入[狂热]状态，并使[狂热心流]回复至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 终结技：终幕演出
fields.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
fields.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力穿梭斩击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，简将直接进入[狂热]状态，并使[狂热心流]回复至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies with a powerful attack in a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 快速支援：乌刺
fields.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次斩击，随后向下突刺，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 快速支援：勾手跳
fields.trigger: [狂热]状态下，当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: While in the Passion state, when the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
[狂热]状态下，当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多次快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
While in the Passion state, when the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 招架支援：最后防线
fields.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 支援突击：疾风扫
fields.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
fields.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起后对敌人发动快速斩击，随后在前方大范围内再次发动横扫斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Leap up and swiftly slash the enemy, then execute a wide sweeping slash across a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 核心被动：洞察
fields.trigger: 简攻击命中敌人时，会使其陷入[啮咬]状态，持续10秒；队伍中任意角色对处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人触发[强击]并施加[畏缩]效果时，[畏缩]效果的持续时间提升5秒；对处于[啮咬]状态下的敌人造成的[强击]伤害有概率触发暴击，基础暴击率为40%，暴击伤害为50%，简的每点异常精通会使该效果的暴击率额外提升0.16%。
fields.triggerEn: When Jane's attacks hit an enemy, it causes them to enter the Gnawed state, lasting for 10s. If any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state and causes the Flinch effect, the Flinch effect duration is extended by 5s. Assault DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit against enemies in the Gnawed state, with a base CRIT Rate of 40% and CRIT DMG of 50%. Each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency further increases this CRIT Rate by 0.16%.

fields.trigger: 队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
fields.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
简的物理异常积蓄效率提升20%，当敌人已经处于属性异常状态下时，简对其累积的物理异常积蓄值额外提升15%。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 20%. When the enemy is already suffering from an Attribute Anomaly, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup towards the target is increased by an additional 15%.
